name: Control Weather
components: V, S, M (burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water)
description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early. The full table of weather stages is on this spell's page in the Player's Handbook; the text layer of the supplied PDF does not include it.

name: Trap the Soul
components: V, S, M (a gem or crystal prison; see the Player's Handbook for its cost)
description: You imprison a creature's soul in a gem. The full rules (the two ways to cast it, the saving throw and the gem's cost) are on this spell's page in the Player's Handbook; the text layer of the supplied PDF does not include them.
